series.title: How-To-Use-AI.com
series.author: Danijel-James Wynyard-McClay
series.about: The how-to-use-ai.com series starts with someone who has never touched AI and finishes with someone who can design AI systems. Each book assumes only what the books before it taught.

books.title: AI for Normal People
books.description: Understanding Artificial Intelligence Without the Hype

dedication.text:
For Johnny,

who has endured more midnight conversations about AI, technology, and whatever else my ADHD brain has decided is fascinating that night than any husband reasonably should.

You listen while I excitedly explain one more idea when we should both be asleep, knowing full well that “one more thing” is never actually one more thing.

And somehow, without fail, you still love me every day.

This book is for you.

epigraph.quote: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.
epigraph.author: Arthur C. Clarke

summary: You've already been using AI in your maps, your inbox, your bank and your streaming queue. This book explains what's actually going on, in plain English, without the hype or the jargon.

AI is software that finds patterns and makes predictions. Once you see it that way, the headlines get less alarming, the tools get more useful, and you can decide for yourself where AI belongs in your life and your work.
backCover.highlightsLead: In this book you'll learn how to:
highlights: Spot the AI you already use every day
Understand what AI can and can't do, and why it sounds so sure of itself
Ask AI tools for what you actually want
Use AI at home and at work without handing over your judgement
